rules.title: A thesis for the doctoral degree must constitute original scholarship and must be a distinct contribution to knowledge
21 credits of courses at the 500 level or above
At least 6 credits at the 600 level or above
The Department recommends that students take complementary courses in at least three different areas of Mathematics and Statistics
Students who wish to take more that 8 credits of complementary courses from outside the Department should request approval from the Graduate Program Director
